🚨🇲🇽 HOMICIDES DOWN 46% UNDER SHEINBAUM — MAY 2026 IS THE LOWEST MAY SINCE 2015

Daily homicides fell from 86.9 (Sept 2024) to 47.3 (May 2026) — a 46% drop in 20 months. Over 56,000 detentions for high-impact crimes, nearly 30,000 firearms seized, 420 tons of drugs recovered (including 5 million fentanyl pills), and 2,407 clandestine labs dismantled.

The strategy: intelligence, coordination, address root causes. No mass incarceration, no Bukele theater, no US 'war on drugs' recipe. Sheinbaum: 'I want to publicly recognize the security cabinet — my gratitude, my admiration for the work they do.'

Source: La Jornada

BREITBART: "CJNG Gunmen Ambush Cops in Mexico: Shooting 10, Five Died"
June 15, 2026 | 🔴

📰 An ambush near Nahuatzen, Michoacán, gets folded into the larger narrative: Mexican authorities "have confirmed the attack" but "little has been done to capture the gunmen." The implication — Sheinbaum's sovereignty stance is why cops keep dying.

The article ties this to her "resistance to U.S. pressure on cartel eradication and her protection of cartel-linked politicians."

🔴 What's missing: the Sig Sauers and Glocks the cartels are using were trafficked south from Arizona dealers. The same week, Center for International Policy documented the supply chain. Breitbart doesn't mention guns. The blame stays one-directional.

REUTERS/AOL: Trump on USMCA: "We don't need anything Mexico has"
June 16, 2026 | 🤡

📰 As US-Mexico negotiators sit down for round two on agriculture and energy, Trump tells reporters: "I'm not looking to renew it… We don't need anything that Canada has. We don't need anything that Mexico has, but they need everything that we have."

The framing repeats the line as a quirky Trump moment. The reality: $1.6 trillion annual regional trade. Mexico is the US's #1 trading partner. The "we don't need them" line erases who actually grows the tomatoes, who actually assembles the cars, who is actually the largest US export market.

🔴 The article notes "analysts suggest his remarks may be a negotiating tactic." No Mexican voices in the piece pushing back.

STIMSON CENTER: "Is Claudia Sheinbaum Head of State or Head of Her Party?"
June 10, 2026 | 🔴

📰 US think tank asks if Sheinbaum is "head of state" or just a Morena partisan. The framing assumes the answer: she's the latter. The trigger? She won't hand over a sitting governor to a DOJ indictment Mexico's courts haven't reviewed.

The question Stimson doesn't ask: which US president would extradite his own state governor on a foreign indictment, no due process attached.

🔍 The April Rocha Moya indictment is treated as self-evidently legitimate; Mexico's position that extraditions follow Mexican law is treated as "party loyalty." Sovereignty rebranded as corruption.

HANNITY/FOX: US drug czar credits "fear of Trump" for Mexico cartel cooperation
June 15, 2026 | 🔴

📰 US drug czar Sara Carter on Hannity: Mexico cooperates "because Trump means what he says." Operation that killed El Mencho was carried out "at the behest" of Washington. The framing erases Mexican forces, Mexican intel, Mexican casualties — and recasts a sovereign operation as a US franchise.

Sheinbaum's response: "collaboration without subordination." The interview tries to convert that into surrender.

• "They cooperated with us… And we'd never seen that before, not like that."
• "If you do not cooperate with us, we are going to target you and you will regret it."
• "Follow the money… That's their heartbeat."

🇲🇽🌎 <u>US SHARE OF MEXICO'S FDI DROPS TO 38.8% — DIVERSIFICATION ACCELERATES</u>

El Economista reports US share of foreign investment in Mexico fell to 38.8% in 2025, below the five-year average of 42.3%. In 15 states, the US is no longer the top investor — Canada leads in SLP and Veracruz, Japan in Tamaulipas, France in Puebla, Netherlands in Estado de México.

Total FDI still hit a record $40.871 billion in 2025 and $23.591 billion in Q1 2026 alone. Mexico isn't losing investment — it's gaining it from everywhere while reducing dependency on a single country.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>91% OF MEXICANS WOULD NOT VOTE PRI — DE LAS HERAS POLL</u>

De las Heras Demotecnia, June 2026 National Survey: 9 out of 10 Mexicans say they would NOT vote for the PRI. The party that ruled Mexico for 71 years now polls at 9% — dead even with PAN. Morena dominates at 44%.

The numbers tell the story of a party that sold Mexico to neoliberalism for seven decades and got its answer at the ballot box. 91% rejection isn't a slump. It's a verdict.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SINALOA: 11 ARRESTED, 6 DRUG LABS DISMANTLED, $6.3M HIT TO CARTELS</u>

Federal forces arrested 11 across Sinaloa including regional leader Iván "N." Six drug production sites dismantled in Culiacán and Cosalá — 5,490 liters of chemical precursors, 250 kg of materials, an organic synthesis reactor, and 7 kg of opium gum seized.

A Barrett rifle, 43 long weapons, 7 IEDs, and 49 blasting caps also confiscated. Authorities estimate 110 million pesos in direct economic damage to criminal organizations from a single coordinated operation.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM HITS 71% APPROVAL — BEATS AMLO BY 1 POINT</u>

De las Heras Demotecnia, June 2026: Claudia Sheinbaum at 71% favorable opinion, 7.2 out of 10 approval rating — one point above López Obrador. Morena at 47% party identification. PRI and PAN tied at 9% each.

"They've paid for a tremendous campaign against me," Sheinbaum said. "Whoever bets on Mexico doing poorly always loses."

🔥🇲🇽 <u>SCJN BLOCKS MINISTER FROM SALINAS PLIEGO MINING CASE — UNANIMOUS VOTE</u>

The Supreme Court unanimously declared Minister María Estela Ríos González ineligible in two amparos filed by Desarrollos Zapal — Ricardo Salinas Pliego's mining company seeking 500 hectares in Baja California Sur for an open-pit gold mine.

Minister Loretta Ortiz argued Ríos had signed the original matter at Sedatu before reaching the bench. The Court agreed: conflict of interest, no exceptions. Not even for the oligarch's lawyers.
